'''Gemmer Sojan''' was a [[human]] [[rebel pilot]] who in [[3 ABY]] was stationed in [[Echo Base]] on the [[planet]] [[Hoth]]. After the [[Galactic Empire]] discovered the base, Sojan attended a briefing by [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] shortly before the base was [[Battle of Hoth|evacuated]]. Sojan survived the evacuation and participated in the [[Battle of Endor]] in [[4 ABY]], [[pilot]]ing an [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor]] during the attack on the [[DS-2 Death Star II Mobile Battle Station|Death Star II]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|All troop carriers will assemble at the north entrance. The heavy transport ships will leave as soon as they're loaded. Only two fighter escorts per ship. The energy shield can only be opened for a short time, so you'll have to stay very close to your transports.|Leia Organa briefs the assembled pilots|audio=LeiaBriefing-ESB.flac|<ref name="ESB" />}}
The [[human]]<ref name="ESB" /> Gemmer Sojan was a [[Rebel pilot|pilot]] who flew in the [[Rebel Alliance Starfighter Corps|Starfighter Corps]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="AMG" /> In [[3 ABY]],<ref name="ESBDate">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of {{Film|V}} to [[3 ABY]].</ref> Sojan was among the [[pilot]]s stationed at [[Echo Base]], the secret rebel headquarters on the [[planet]] [[Hoth]]. After the [[Galactic Empire]] discovered the base, the rebels began preparing to evacuate. Once they arrived in the [[Hoth system]], the Imperials [[blockade]]d Hoth with [[Star Destroyer]]s in preparation to [[Battle of Hoth|attack]] the base. [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] then briefed the base's pilots on the plan in one of the [[hangar]]s, with Sojan and<ref name="ESB" /> [[Tarrin Datch|Tarrin]]<ref name="CL">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2016)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> running to arrive last to the briefing.<ref name="ESB" />

Organa explained that the pilots would be flying in pairs to escort the [[GR-75 medium transport]]s being used for the evacuation through the blockade, with the [[deflector shield]] that the rebels had around Echo Base being opened briefly to let them through. Sojan then nodded when the princess asked if those present had understood, after which<ref name="ESB" /> [[Major]] [[Bren Derlin]]<ref name="CL" /> dismissed the pilots, causing Sojan and the others to rush off into the hangar. With an [[V-150 Planet Defender|ion cannon]] disabling the blockade Star Destroyers from the ground,<ref name="ESB" /> thirteen of the thirty rebel transports successfully escaped Hoth,<ref name="CL" /> with Sojan among those who survived the evacuation.<ref name="AMG" />

In [[4 ABY]],<ref name="ROTJDate">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of {{Film|VI}} to [[4 ABY]].</ref> Sojan flew an [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor]] during the [[Battle of Endor]],<ref name="AMG" /> in which the [[Rebel Alliance Navy|rebel fleet]] attacked the Empire's [[DS-2 Death Star II Mobile Battle Station|Death Star II]] [[superweapon]] while it was under construction over the [[moon]] [[Endor]] in the [[Endor system]]. Although the battle had been a trap set up by [[Galactic Emperor]] [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]], the rebels managed to disable the [[Death Star]]'s shields and then destroy it.<ref name="ROTJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
Gemmer Sojan had [[Color|black]] [[hair]] and light skin.<ref name="ESB" />

==Equipment==
While on Hoth, Sojan wore an orange [[flight suit]], with a white [[flak vest]], a gray [[Diagnostech life support unit]], a white [[flight harness]], white [[glove]]s, and black [[boot]]s. The pilot's [[K-22995 light flight helmet]] was white with a black emblem on the side consisting of a circle with lines through it.<ref name="ESB" />

==Behind the scenes==
Gemmer Sojan first appeared in the [[1980]] [[original trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']].<ref name="ESB" />The character's scene was filmed on the ''Star Wars Stage'' at [[Elstree Studios]] on [[May 22]], [[1979]].<ref name="MakingOf">''[[The Making of The Empire Strikes Back]]''</ref> According to fan site Aveleyman, [[Anthony Guilding]] portrayed the character and can also be seen as a rebel crewmember in the [[1983]] sequel, [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']].<ref name="Aveleyman">{{WebCite|url=http://www.aveleyman.com/ActorCredit.aspx?ActorID=77139|text=Anthony Guilding|work=[http://www.aveleyman.com Aveleyman]|archivedate=20181105081427}}</ref> In the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], Sojan was first identified on a card in the [[2024]] ''[[Battle Over Endor]]'' set for [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Second Edition]]'' board game, appearing before release on the set's product page.<ref name="AMG" />

In the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, the character of [[Gemmer Sojan/Legends|Gemmer Sojan]], initially known as just Gemmer, originated in [[Star Wars (1977) 55|''Star Wars'' (1977) 55]], the fifty-fifth issue in the [[Star Wars (1977)|''Marvel Star Wars'']] series of comics, which was written by [[David Michelinie]], illustrated by [[Walter Simonson]],<ref name="SW55">[[Star Wars (1977) 55|''Star Wars'' (1977) 55]]</ref> and published on [[October 20]], [[1981]].<ref name="tcr">''[[Amazing Heroes]]'' #5, [[Wikipedia:The_Comic_Reader#On_the_Drawing_Board.2FThe_Comic_Reader|''The Comic Reader'']] #195 and [[Wikipedia:The Comics Journal|''The Comics Journal'']] #67</ref> The character's surname was first revealed in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="EGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> The character was then [[Retroactive continuity|retconned]] into appearing in ''The Empire Strikes Back'' in the article "[[Rogues Gallery (department)|Rogues Gallery: Clearance for Immediate Launch]]," which was published in [[Star Wars Insider 146|''Star Wars Insider'' 146]]<ref name="Insider">{{InsiderCite|146|Rogues Gallery|Rogues Gallery: Clearance for Immediate Launch}}</ref> on [[December 10]], [[2013]].<ref name="Date">[[Star Wars Insider 145|''Star Wars Insider'' 145]]</ref>
